harness.coder_prompt: You are an expert Rust engineer. Write one complete, self-contained Rust source file that satisfies the task, using only the standard library. Respond with the whole file in a single ```rust fenced code block and nothing else. Include an empty `fn main() {}` (the file is compiled as a program).
lessons: Translate requirements into explicit invariants and ordered validation phases; validate complete inputs before transformation, evaluation, or mutation.
Separate parsing, syntax validation, semantic checks, and value processing; define delimiter, encoding, empty-value, and error-precedence rules explicitly.
Track source byte offsets, indices, boundaries, and cursors throughout processing; report errors at the earliest specified position.
Compute fallible outcomes before committing state; preserve atomicity, input order, and branch-local state when searching or mutating.
Model boundary and successor rules explicitly; reduce exact values before applying representation limits, and guard long-running arithmetic against overflow.
Build shared semantic primitives before derived behavior; test interactions, edge cases, deterministic tie-breaking, and formatting order.
